<MethodEndpoint method={'post'} path={'/api/v1/organizations/integrations/{organizationIntegrationId}/verify'} context={'endpoint'}></MethodEndpoint>

Verify the credentials of an organization integration: resolves the organization's stored service account credentials, parses them, and exchanges them with Google for an OAuth access token. Returns `204` when the credentials verify and `422` when they do not. The outcome is not persisted: nothing transitions `state` yet.
